why: RC39 first 24/24 used a powerful perfect counterexample/equivalence oracle. Verify whether finite source-only membership queries can replace that stronger interface without exposing hidden transition graph.
scope: POST-FIRST rights ablation on SAME already opened original 24 deterministic state machines. NOT independent unseen-family transfer.

source_rights.allowed: membership(word): one complete output string per chosen input, fixed upper bound true state count ≤5, input alphabet ABC and output alphabet 01
source_rights.forbidden: access to hidden state count, transition graph, direct all-length product counterexample oracle or labeled target program in the learner
source_rights.finite_conformance: Enumerate ALL words of length ≤ (5 + candidate_state_count - 1), since a pair of deterministic Mealy machines with at most n and m states, if distinct, has a distinguishing word of length ≤n+m-1 under partition refinement of their disjoint union. Every checked word charged as a source membership request.

gate: 24/24 independently product-proven all-length generated programs, zero invalid certificates; strict charge of all membership calls, including those used by finite conformance.
interpretation: Even 24/24 would prove a scoped classical source-only finite-state learner under a 5-state assumption, not neural Q3, independent Q6 or 10x cost. Strong equal-rights classical L* is the same policy.
fallback: UNKNOWN if 100k unique word budget or other source cap exceeded; never assert all-length certainty without complete finite conformance and independently checking hidden product.
